prompt_prefix:
Answer this question about the local repository. Cite source paths and line numbers, and state any uncertainty. You may use the available repository tools. Do not edit files, use the web, inspect other repositories, or delegate to other agents.

When specialized repository-context tools are available, prefer them for initial discovery and relationship queries. Use semantic search when implementation names are unknown, exact symbol lookup for known names, and graph tools for relevant call or inheritance relationships. Otherwise use native repository search. Start with 3..5 results and expand only when needed. Follow only relationships needed to answer the question. For implementation questions, request a bounded source excerpt when symbol lookup offers it. Use returned code directly when it supports the answer. Read additional source only to resolve a specific evidence gap, such as omitted context or truncation. Stop when the answer and citations are supported. Treat missing static edges as incomplete evidence.
